purpose: 148 complete ORIGINAL NativeZipper runs:40 modular mechanical cases and108 rational endpoint calls on9 fixed maps,dimensions1..3,both ends and every row. Raw cases include zero coefficients,positive/negative static signs,upper increment overflow,zero dimension and products wrapping modulo2^m;these test the controller only,not exact rational semantics outside its hypotheses. Rational expected choices use direct rational inequalities;expected output uses original leftPair/rightPair. Checks every source/unit/zero/fuel word,grid,all4 work products,all3 output words,START/STOP,halt,blank scratch and all14 unequal absolute head positions. Scratch permits explicit blank suffix cells. Initial dimension/index/seed resources are supplied;new grid/work/output tapes are blank. No claim of paid cleanup between endpoint invocations.

import TransposeFollowup.EndpointClipRational
open TransposeFollowup

def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def shiftMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := -1; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def poleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := -2; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def coefficientMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1 / 2; b := 1 / 3; c := 1 / 5; d := 1; lo := -1 / 2; hi := 3 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def outsideMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 2; hi := 3
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def cases : List RationalMobius :=
  [identityMap, doubleMap, fractionalMap, shiftMap, poleMap, coefficientMap, outsideMap]


def negativeMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := -2; hi := -1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def zeroHiMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := -1; hi := 0
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

open FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit

def portIndex : EndpointClip.Port → Nat
  | .dimension => 0 | .index => 1 | .unit => 2 | .zero => 3 | .fuel => 4 | .scratch => 5 | .grid => 6
  | .work j => 7+j.val | .out j => 11+j.val

def ports : List EndpointClip.Port :=
  [.dimension,.index,.unit,.zero,.fuel,.scratch,.grid] ++
    (List.finRange 4).map EndpointClip.Port.work ++ (List.finRange 3).map EndpointClip.Port.out

def heads (p : EndpointClip.Port) : Int := 17*(portIndex p : Int)-103

def checkCase (A B : Nat) (upper negative : Bool) (n i : List Bool)
    (expectedGrid : Bool) (expectedOut : Nat × Nat × Nat) : Bool :=
  let m := n.length
  let N := Counter.value n
  let I := Counter.value i
  let J := (I+(if upper then 1 else 0))%2^m
  let work : Fin 4 → Nat := ![A%2^m,B%2^m,(A*N)%2^m,(B*J)%2^m]
  let out : Fin 3 → Nat := ![expectedOut.1,expectedOut.2.1,expectedOut.2.2]
  let c := NativeZipper.run (EndpointClip.program A B upper negative)
    (71*m+187+2*(A+B)*(18*m+52))
    (EndpointClip.zipperCfg (.grid (.init (.erase 0))) (EndpointClip.initial n i) heads)
  decide (c.core.pc = .done expectedGrid) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .dimension = Counter.marked n) && decide (c.core.tapes .index = Counter.marked i) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .unit = Counter.marked (true::List.replicate (m-1) false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .zero = Counter.marked (List.replicate m false)) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .fuel = Counter.marked [true]) &&
    decide (c.core.tapes .grid = Counter.marked (bits m J)) &&
    decide ((c.core.tapes .scratch).left = [.start]) &&
    (c.core.tapes .scratch).right.all (fun s => decide (s = .blank)) &&
    (List.finRange 4).all (fun j => decide (c.core.tapes (.work j) = Counter.marked (bits m (work j)))) &&
    (List.finRange 3).all (fun j => decide (c.core.tapes (.out j) = Counter.marked (bits m (out j)))) &&
    ports.all (fun p => decide (c.pos p = heads p))

def checks : Nat × Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut raw := 0
  let mut rational := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for seed in List.range 40 do
    let m := 1+seed%6
    let A := seed%4
    let B := 1+(seed/3)%4
    let upper := seed%2 == 0
    let negative := (seed/2)%2 == 0
    let N := (13*seed+1)%2^m
    let I := (7*seed+3)%2^m
    let J := (I+(if upper then 1 else 0))%2^m
    let left := (A*N)%2^m
    let right := (B*J)%2^m
    let grid := if negative then !upper else if upper then decide (right<=left) else decide (left<=right)
    let out := if grid then (J,0,N) else if negative then (0,A%2^m,B%2^m) else (A%2^m,0,B%2^m)
    raw := raw+1
    if !checkCase A B upper negative (bits m N) (bits m I) grid out then failures := failures+1
  for F in cases ++ [negativeMap,zeroHiMap] do
    for N in [1,2,3] do
      let xs := bits N.size N
      let nw := PaddedWord.word (PaddedWord.commonConstant F) id xs
      for i in List.finRange N do
        for upper in [false,true] do
          let q := if upper then F.hi else F.lo
          let p := if upper then F.rightPair i else F.leftPair i
          let grid := decide (if upper then ((i.val : Rat)+1)/N<=q else q<=(i.val : Rat)/N)
          rational := rational+1
          if !checkCase q.num.natAbs q.den upper (decide (q.num<0)) nw (bits nw.length i.val)
              grid (p.1.toNat,(-p.1).toNat,p.2.toNat) then failures := failures+1
  return (raw,rational,failures)
#eval checks
